episodes.synopsis: A university student asks Akuma Kun to investigate the strange deaths of two of her friends, who both died on the same exact date and time.
episodes.title: Demons

episodes.synopsis: Hina looks after Ichika, but danger still lurks nearby. Akuma Kun further investigates the case by making another visit to the Asanagi house.
episodes.title: Gluttony

episodes.synopsis: Akuma Kun and Mephisto III get invited to the home of a very wealthy client, who has a disturbing request — to summon Satan for his flesh.
episodes.title: Greed

episodes.synopsis: A famous movie director in his twilight years asks Akuma Kun and Mephisto III to find a long-lost, cursed film made by his dear friend.
episodes.title: Envy

episodes.synopsis: At his wit's end, a landlord breaks into the apartment of a tenant who stopped paying rent — and discovers a gruesome, seemingly impossible murder.
episodes.title: Angel

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in Easter Island to investigate a strange red nail, Akuma Kun and Mephisto III discover the body of a murdered young woman.
episodes.title: Love and Hate

episodes.synopsis: After years of hard work, a long-time legislator is on the verge of becoming a Cabinet minister. But then, a threatening man pays him a visit.
episodes.title: Human

episodes.synopsis: A little boy goes into the Millenarianism Research Institute saying he wants to become a demon, but Akuma Kun immediately throws him out.
episodes.title: True Intentions

episodes.synopsis: On a dark and stormy night, a ghastly looking man comes looking for Sanae. He turns out to be her husband, who's been missing for five years.
episodes.title: Father

episodes.synopsis: While trying out the pancakes at a new neighborhood restaurant, Mephisto III and Akuma Kun remember the day they first met.
episodes.title: Celebration

episodes.synopsis: When Shingo — aka the first Akuma Kun — is sealed away, the father and son Mephistos set out to rescue him, while Akuma Kun takes a different approach.
episodes.title: Play

episodes.synopsis: Akuma Kun, Gremory and Mephisto III enter the barrier to save Shingo. But first, they'll have to confront Strophaia, an old enemy from Ichiro's past.
episodes.title: Sacrifice
